## Site Identity
name: Kitesurf Passion
url: https://kitesurfpassion.fr
type: Professional Water Sports School
location: Hyères, Presqu'île de Giens, Var, France
established: 1999

## Description
Kitesurf Passion is a professional water sports school specializing in kitesurf, wingfoil, and pumpfoil instruction. Located on the Mediterranean coast at L'Almanarre beach near Hyères, France, the school offers:

- State-certified instruction (BPJEPS diploma)
- Safety-first approach with dedicated assistance boat
- Small group lessons for personalized coaching
- Premium Duotone equipment
- Mobile school adapting to optimal wind conditions
- Over 25 years of teaching experience
